definitions.explanation: the total amount spent by a government or public institution within a fiscal year on public services, social programs, infrastructure, etc.

notes:
GOVERNMENT/ECONOMICS TERM:
{歳出|さいしゅつ} is the counterpart to ⟦{歳入|さいにゅう}→歳入：08769_sainyuu⟧ (revenue) in budget discussions. These two terms are fundamental to understanding government finances.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歳出|さいしゅつ}⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧ - expenditure budget
- {歳出|さいしゅつ}⟦{削減|さくげん}→削減：11789_sakugen⟧ - spending cuts
- {歳出|さいしゅつ}⟦{増加|ぞうか}→増加：03329_zouka⟧ - increased spending
- ⟦{歳入|さいにゅう}→歳入：08769_sainyuu⟧{歳出|さいしゅつ} - revenue and expenditure
